create_ModelWithNormalize: create a ModelWithNormalize wrapper that L2-normalizes model outputs along dimension 1
create_ModelWithIntermediateLayers: create a ModelWithIntermediateLayers wrapper to extract features from the last N blocks of a model
run_evaluate: run the evaluate function to compute metrics on a model using a data loader and postprocessors
run_extract_features: run extract_features to compute and gather feature embeddings from a model across a dataset
run_all_gather_and_flatten: run all_gather_and_flatten to gather tensors from all distributed processes and flatten them
